device_entry.name: Sunbrick 多通道可调光谱LED光源模块
device_entry.name_en: Sunbrick Multi-Channel Tunable Spectrum LED Light Module
tags: 可调光谱照明与光照实验
device_entry.description: Sunbrick 是一种多通道、可联网的 LED 光源模块，可按通道调节输出值、设置整体强度因子、加载预设光谱，并监测模块节点温度。它适合在实验室中提供可编程、可重复的光照条件，用于光学测试、材料表征及其他需要可调光谱照明的实验。
device_entry.description_en: The Sunbrick is a multi-channel, networkable LED light module that allows per-channel output control, overall intensity adjustment, preset spectrum loading, and node temperature monitoring. It is used in laboratories to provide programmable and repeatable illumination for optical testing, material characterization, and other experiments requiring tunable spectral lighting.
